score_notes.A: Front matter fine (two-level categories, use_math with $$ present, description 140 chars). Deductions: em-dash/blank cells in tables (L148 '—', L878 'llama.cpp | — | —'); Korean '~한다' code comments (L543, L605, L610, L773) in a 입니다 post.
score_notes.B: Mostly natural 입니다 prose. Terminology drifts: 수명주기 (L110) vs 라이프사이클 (L82, L798); 컨텍스트 창 (L228) vs 컨텍스트 윈도우; '단계' used for both stage and phase (L212 '모델 호출이나 도구 실행 같은 단계', L216 '스테이지마다 Input, Wrap, Output 세 단계'). Formulaic 'X에서 눈여겨볼 ...' openers (L96, L794). Repeated restatement in L886 ('한도·취소·재시도·개입' twice in two sentences).
score_notes.C: L742 says handle_request '이 두 함수를 차례로 부릅니다' but the handle_request code (L407) calls neither; L760 then says serve_summary_request replaces it. L208 says the structured-output path drops events before structured output is explained; only L435 reveals it is the deprecated Agent.structured_output() path. L882 '앞서 만든 approval_gate 승인 단계가 바로 이 공식 경로에 해당합니다' conflates middleware interrupt with HumanInTheLoop.
score_notes.D: Good worked tables at the hard points (hook nesting L145, intervention resolution L468, structured-output attempt counting L420, token overshoot L644, retry schedule L514). Some padding: TL;DR (L13-15) previews nearly every section; L96, L806 explain the obvious.
score_notes.E: Tables and code used well; formula N<=3k (L283) and 0.75^3 (L855) fit. No real figure: the loop is ASCII art (L50-63) instead of the docs' loop diagram. Provider table row 'llama.cpp | — | —' (L878) is empty/wrong against the Model Providers table (Python yes, TypeScript no).
score_notes.F: All 15 sampled claims supported. Outside the sample: (1) L878 llama.cpp language cells '—' while docs list Python supported / TypeScript not; (2) L830 attributes principalResolver ('승인을 받을 주체인 principal') to HumanInTheLoop, but in the docs it is CedarAuthorization's principal_resolver deciding who may call delete_files; (3) L794 claims '요약 본문은 정상 완료일 때만 응답에 담깁니다' but serve_summary_request never passes structured_output_model, so summary is always None (verified). Minor: L161 'BeforeModelCallEvent.cancel ... Python 목록에는 없습니다' matches the guide page list but the cited Python API page (strands.hooks.events) does define cancel. Not deducted: L525 max_delay default 128 follows the Retry Strategies doc, though installed 1.63.0 code has max_delay=240.
score_notes.T1: Imports all resolve on 1.63.0 (ToolResultEvent from strands.types._events is the same object as strands.middleware.ToolResultEvent). But the running example's final handler is broken: serve_summary_request (L762-792) and summarize_within_budget (L658-682) omit structured_output_model=DocumentSummary, so result.structured_output is None and SummaryReply(outcome='ok', summary=None) is returned (run with a fake model). handle_request (L405) uses a module-level shared Agent(), against the post's own per-request rule. Snippets at L277 and L308 use an undefined `agent`; the HITL snippet (L821-828) never imports HumanInTheLoop and is not merged into build_summary_agent; DocumentToolGuard (L183) is never registered. No install line.
score_notes.T2: Covers the sources' important topics (agent loop, hooks, middleware, structured output, interventions/steering, retry, conversation management, lifecycle limits/cancel, HITL, observability/eval) in a sensible order; nothing unsupported padded in.
score_notes.T3: Strong internals: hook ordering and mutable fields, middleware-vs-hook layering, structured output as a tool, retry stacking, limit-check timing and overshoot, cooperative cancellation, fail-closed classifier, deployment pattern, observability/eval gate, and when to choose vs LangGraph. Design advice is marked as the writer's judgement (L888).
